findings.text: The task folder has no `requirements.md` (only `past-work.md`, `session.jsonl`, `review/diff.patch`), and `session.jsonl` holds only a truncated title ("You are the AI system architect for one design question…"), so a fresh agent cannot see the owner's actual question or check the doc against it. Add the ask, or a link to the dictation it came from.

The task has no outcome: `past-work.md` lists it as "(no outcome logged)" and `session.jsonl` ends at a commit line (dd2ac9813). Log a result line that links `public/framework/ux/Dictate/doc/fast-and-smart.md`, and list the six decisions in section 6 as open questions so they are not lost in a doc nobody reopens (law 5).

`doc/fast-and-smart.md` is only linked from `Dictate/readme.md:65`. `doc/pipeline.md:111` and `doc/whisper-timeline.md:32` link `wake-policy.md` as the seat/wake reference but not this doc, and `doc/chat-notes.md` / `chat-shape.md` (the doc says `chat-shape.md:17` is wrong) are not corrected. Add a link from `pipeline.md`'s links line, and either fix `chat-shape.md:17` or log it as a task.

The doc says `session-smart.md:1` ("Opus 5.5") is stale, but that line now reads "You run on Opus 5.5 … (the owner, 2026-10-25)", which looks like an owner statement. `tiers.js:12` still maps `voice_smart` to Sonnet. Phrase it as a conflict for the owner to settle rather than a stale line to fix, since recommendation row "Stale heading" would overwrite their words.

The doc is design only, as asked: no code changed (the diff touches only the new doc and one readme paragraph). Spot checks hold: `send_on_comma: false` (`Mic.js:30`), `answer_quiet_ms` 2500 and `hold_max_ms` 8000 (`Sessions.js:246`), tail mode exists (`Sessions.js:281`), and Haiku 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5 in `tiers.js`. Line numbers will drift as `Sessions.js` changes; most citations carry a function name too, which helps.

Simpler path: section 5 offers four experiment moves, and moves 2 and 3 (per-session model/effort and prompt override) both touch `Sessions.js` spawn specs. They could be one setting rather than two proposals if built.

Deliverables 1 and 2 are met: `ux/Dictate/doc/fast-and-smart.md` has the job-by-seat table, gaps, split, model/effort per seat and the safe-experiment section, and is linked from `Dictate/readme.md`, `doc/pipeline.md` and `doc/files.jsonl`. I did not re-check the code line numbers it cites (`Sessions.js`, `tiers.js`), and they will go stale fast, so a reader should treat them as hints.

Deliverable 3, the under-150-word report to the owner, is not in the task folder. The folder holds only requirements.md, past-work.md and the jsonl logs, so I could not check the word count or the decisions list. The requirements "Outcome" line does point to section 6 of the doc, which is enough to continue from.
The doc is 87 lines with seven tables and lists. That is long for "one page", but each section is needed; the table in section 2 carries the answer.

The `chat-shape.md` row 17 error is logged in `ux/Dictate/improvements.jsonl` rather than fixed. That fits "design only", and the file is indexed in `Dictate/files.jsonl`. The file itself is under `ai/sessions/2026/10/20/.../dictation-debug/`, outside the Dictate module, so the improvement entry is the right place to leave it.
`Dictate/files.jsonl` gained a redundant `failures.jsonl` gone/present flip. That is tool churn, not a defect.
The Opus-versus-Sonnet conflict (`session-smart.md:1` against `tiers.js`) is surfaced for the owner instead of being silently resolved. That is correct, because the line is the owner's own.

fixed: outcome and the six open decisions are in requirements.md and the report to the owner
fixed: linked from pipeline.md; chat-shape.md row 17 logged as an improvement in ux/Dictate/improvements.jsonl
fixed: doc now frames the Opus heading as an owner conflict with tiers.js
